import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.CRC32C;

/** Bounded local journal, not a broker. Cooperating single-classloader owners only.
 * Requires local Linux-like filesystem with stable fileKey, advisory locks and directory force.
 * While owned, nobody may replace paths, hard-link segment files or open/close the lock file.
 * No replication, consumer offsets, expiry or automatic repair of complete corrupt frames.
 */
public final class SegmentJournal implements AutoCloseable {
    public static final int MAX_BODY = 1_048_576, MAX_RECORDS = 10_000;
    public static final long MAX_LOG_BYTES = 16L * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int MAGIC = 0x4A4E4C31, HEADER = 20;
    private record Identity(FileSystem fs, Object key) { }
    private record Owner(Path dir, Identity directory, Identity lockIdentity,
                         FileChannel channel, FileLock lock) { }
    private static final Map<Identity, Owner> OWNERS = new HashMap<>();
    public record Record(long sequence, String id, byte[] payload) {
        public Record { payload = payload.clone(); }
        @Override public byte[] payload() { return payload.clone(); }
    }
    @FunctionalInterface interface Fault { void afterWrite() throws IOException; }
    private final Owner owner;
    private final int segmentBytes;
    private final Fault fault;
    private final LinkedHashMap<String, Record> index = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private FileChannel active;
    private long bytes;
    private boolean poisoned, closed;

    private static Identity identity(Path p, boolean directory) throws IOException {
        BasicFileAttributes a = Files.readAttributes(p, BasicFileAttributes.class, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        if (a.fileKey() == null || (directory ? !a.isDirectory() : !a.isRegularFile()))
            throw new IOException("stable file identity required: " + p);
        return new Identity(p.getFileSystem(), a.fileKey());
    }
    private static void syncDirectory(Path p) throws IOException {
        try (FileChannel c = FileChannel.open(p, StandardOpenOption.READ)) { c.force(true); }
    }
    private static synchronized Owner acquire(Path input) throws IOException {
        // Caller creates its dedicated directory. Resolving symlinks prevents in-JVM directory aliases.
        Path dir = input.toRealPath();
        Identity d = identity(dir, true);
        Path lp = dir.resolve("journal.lock");
        Identity before = Files.exists(lp, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) ? identity(lp, false) : null;
        if (OWNERS.containsKey(d) || (before != null && OWNERS.containsKey(before)))
            throw new IOException("journal already owned in JVM");
        FileChannel c = null;
        FileLock l = null;
        try {
            c = FileChannel.open(lp, StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.READ,
                    StandardOpenOption.WRITE, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
            Identity actual = identity(lp, false);
            if ((before != null && !before.equals(actual)) || OWNERS.containsKey(actual))
                throw new IOException("lock identity changed");
            l = c.tryLock();
            if (l == null) throw new IOException("journal owned by another process");
            syncDirectory(dir);
            Owner o = new Owner(dir, d, actual, c, l);
            OWNERS.put(d, o); OWNERS.put(actual, o);
            return o;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) {
            // Closing a newly opened alias can release POSIX locks. Alias detection must precede open.
            if (c != null) try { c.close(); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if(e != cleanup)e.addSuppressed(cleanup); }
            throw e;
        }
    }
    private static synchronized void forget(Owner o) {
        OWNERS.remove(o.directory(), o); OWNERS.remove(o.lockIdentity(), o);
    }
    public SegmentJournal(Path dir) throws IOException { this(dir, 2 * 1024 * 1024, () -> { }); }
    public SegmentJournal(Path dir, int segmentBytes) throws IOException { this(dir, segmentBytes, () -> { }); }
    SegmentJournal(Path dir, int segmentBytes, Fault fault) throws IOException {
        if (segmentBytes < 64 || segmentBytes > 2 * 1024 * 1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("segment size");
        this.segmentBytes = segmentBytes; this.fault = Objects.requireNonNull(fault);
        owner = acquire(dir);
        try { recover(); }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) {
            try { close(); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if(e != cleanup)e.addSuppressed(cleanup); }
            throw e;
        }
    }
    private static int crc(byte[] raw) { CRC32C c = new CRC32C(); c.update(raw); return (int)c.getValue(); }
    static byte[] utf8(String s) throws CharacterCodingException {
        ByteBuffer b = StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newEncoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).encode(java.nio.CharBuffer.wrap(s));
        byte[] a = new byte[b.remaining()]; b.get(a); return a;
    }
    private static String decode(byte[] b) throws CharacterCodingException {
        return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(b)).toString();
    }
    private static void readFully(FileChannel c, ByteBuffer b) throws IOException {
        while (b.hasRemaining()) { int n = c.read(b); if (n < 0) throw new EOFException(); if (n == 0) throw new IOException("no read progress"); }
    }
    private static void writeFully(FileChannel c, ByteBuffer b) throws IOException {
        while (b.hasRemaining()) if (c.write(b) <= 0) throw new IOException("no write progress");
    }
    private Path segment(long base) { return owner.dir().resolve(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%020d.seg", base)); }
    private void createSegment() throws IOException {
        active = FileChannel.open(segment(index.size()), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW,
                StandardOpenOption.READ, StandardOpenOption.WRITE, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        active.force(true); syncDirectory(owner.dir());
    }
    private void recover() throws IOException {
        List<Path> paths = new ArrayList<>();
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(owner.dir(), "*.seg")) {
            for (Path p : stream) {
                if (paths.size() >= MAX_RECORDS + 1) throw new IOException("too many segments");
                paths.add(p);
            }
        }
        paths.sort(Comparator.naturalOrder());
        long rawSize = 0;
        for (Path p : paths) {
            String n = p.getFileName().toString();
            if (!n.matches("[0-9]{20}\\.seg")) throw new IOException("bad segment name");
            identity(p, false);
            long size = Files.size(p);
            if (size > segmentBytes) throw new IOException("segment exceeds configured limit");
            rawSize = Math.addExact(rawSize, size);
            if (rawSize > MAX_LOG_BYTES) throw new IOException("journal exceeds byte budget");
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < paths.size(); i++) {
            Path p = paths.get(i);
            long base;
            try { base = Long.parseLong(p.getFileName().toString().substring(0, 20)); }
            catch (NumberFormatException e) { throw new IOException("bad segment base", e); }
            if (base != index.size()) throw new IOException("segment sequence gap");
            boolean last = i == paths.size() - 1;
            try (FileChannel c = FileChannel.open(p, StandardOpenOption.READ, StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
                    LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                long at = 0, size = c.size();
                while (at < size) {
                    if (size - at < HEADER) {
                        // A recognizable older frame must never be mistaken for a v2 torn tail.
                        if (size - at >= 6) {
                            c.position(at); ByteBuffer prefix = ByteBuffer.allocate(6); readFully(c, prefix); prefix.flip();
                            if (prefix.getInt() == MAGIC && prefix.getShort() != 2)
                                throw new IOException("unsupported journal format; explicit migration required");
                        }
                        truncateTail(c, at, last); break;
                    }
                    c.position(at); ByteBuffer h = ByteBuffer.allocate(HEADER).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
                    readFully(c, h); h.flip();
                    int magic = h.getInt(); short version = h.getShort(), flags = h.getShort();
                    int length = h.getInt(), expected = h.getInt(), headerCrc = h.getInt();
                    // Version 2 checks framing metadata for accidental corruption before trusting length.
                    if (magic != MAGIC || version != 2 || flags != 0 ||
                            crc(Arrays.copyOf(h.array(), HEADER - 4)) != headerCrc ||
                            length < 17 || length > MAX_BODY)
                        throw new IOException("invalid complete frame header");
                    if (size - at - HEADER < length) { truncateTail(c, at, last); break; }
                    byte[] raw = new byte[length]; readFully(c, ByteBuffer.wrap(raw));
                    if (crc(raw) != expected) throw new IOException("CRC mismatch; preserved for diagnosis");
                    ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(raw).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
                    long seq = b.getLong(); int kl = b.getInt();
                    if (kl < 1 || kl > 1024 || kl > b.remaining() - 4) throw new IOException("bad ID length");
                    byte[] key = new byte[kl]; b.get(key); String id = decode(key);
                    int pl = b.getInt();
                    if (id.isBlank() || pl < 0 || pl != b.remaining() || seq != index.size()
                            || index.containsKey(id) || index.size() >= MAX_RECORDS) throw new IOException("invalid record");
                    byte[] value = new byte[pl]; b.get(value);
                    index.put(id, new Record(seq, id, value)); at += HEADER + (long)length;
                }
                if (!last && c.size() == 0) throw new IOException("empty sealed segment");
                bytes += c.size();
            }
        }
        if (paths.isEmpty()) createSegment();
        else {
            active = FileChannel.open(paths.getLast(), StandardOpenOption.READ, StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
                    LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
            active.position(active.size());
        }
    }
    private static void truncateTail(FileChannel c, long at, boolean last) throws IOException {
        if (!last) throw new IOException("incomplete sealed segment");
        c.truncate(at); c.force(true);
    }
    private void usable() throws IOException {
        if (closed || poisoned) throw new IOException("journal closed or poisoned; reopen and recover");
    }
    public synchronized long append(String id, byte[] input) throws IOException {
        usable();
        if (id == null || id.length() > 1024 || id.isBlank() || input == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("id/payload");
        byte[] key;
        try { key = utf8(id); } catch (CharacterCodingException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("malformed UTF-16 ID", e); }
        long length = 16L + key.length + input.length;
        if (key.length > 1024 || length > MAX_BODY || length + HEADER > segmentBytes)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("frame too large");
        Record old = index.get(id);
        if (old != null) {
            if (!Arrays.equals(old.payload, input)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("same ID, different payload");
            return old.sequence();
        }
        if (index.size() >= MAX_RECORDS || bytes + HEADER + length > MAX_LOG_BYTES)
            throw new IOException("bounded journal full");
        byte[] value = input.clone(); long seq = index.size();
        ByteBuffer body = ByteBuffer.allocate((int)length).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        body.putLong(seq).putInt(key.length).put(key).putInt(value.length).put(value);
        ByteBuffer frame = ByteBuffer.allocate(HEADER + (int)length).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        frame.putInt(MAGIC).putShort((short)2).putShort((short)0).putInt((int)length)
                .putInt(crc(body.array()));
        frame.putInt(crc(Arrays.copyOf(frame.array(), HEADER - 4))).put(body.array()).flip();
        try {
            if (active.size() + frame.remaining() > segmentBytes) {
                active.force(true); active.close(); active = null; createSegment();
            }
            writeFully(active, frame); fault.afterWrite(); active.force(true);
            // The index and caller's ACK follow force, never precede it.
            index.put(id, new Record(seq, id, value)); bytes += HEADER + length; return seq;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) { poisoned = true; throw e; }
    }
    public synchronized byte[] get(String id) throws IOException { usable(); Record r = index.get(id); return r == null ? null : r.payload(); }
    public synchronized int size() throws IOException { usable(); return index.size(); }
    public synchronized List<Record> records() throws IOException {
        usable(); return index.values().stream().map(r -> new Record(r.sequence(), r.id(), r.payload)).toList();
    }
    @Override public synchronized void close() throws IOException {
        if (closed) return;
        closed = true; IOException failure = null;
        if (active != null) {
            try { if (!poisoned) active.force(true); } catch (IOException e) { failure = e; }
            try { active.close(); } catch (IOException e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else if(failure != e)failure.addSuppressed(e); }
        }
        try { owner.channel().close(); } catch (IOException e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else if(failure != e)failure.addSuppressed(e); }
        // A cleanup failure keeps the JVM reservation: fail closed rather than create two owners.
        if (failure == null) forget(owner); else throw failure;
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

/** Durable single-process teaching state machine, backed by SegmentJournal.
 * No SQL, Kafka client, parser, embedding API or search engine is implemented here.
 * Time is trusted authority time supplied by the caller; tests use a deterministic clock.
 */
public final class TaskOrchestrationLab implements AutoCloseable {
    public enum Stage { PARSE, CHUNK, EMBED, INDEX, DONE }
    public enum State { READY, RUNNING, UNKNOWN, CANCEL_REQUESTED, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED }
    public enum Receipt { NOT_STARTED_AND_FENCED, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, UNRESOLVED }
    public record Input(String tenant, String requestId, String document, long version,
                        String snapshot, String sha256, long inputBytes, long deadline, int priority) {
        public Input {
            for (String s : List.of(tenant, requestId, document, snapshot, sha256)) text(s);
            if (!sha256.matches("[a-f0-9]{64}") || version < 1 || inputBytes < 0
                    || inputBytes > 128L * 1024 * 1024 || deadline <= 0 || priority < 0 || priority > 2)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("input contract");
        }
        public String key() { return tenant + "/" + requestId; }
        public String documentKey() { return tenant + "/" + document; }
    }
    public record Task(Input input, Stage stage, State state, long epoch, int attempts,
                       String owner, long leaseUntil, long readyAt, String artifact, long revision) {
        public String operationId() { return input.key() + "/v" + input.version() + "/" + stage; }
    }
    public record Document(long version, boolean deleted, String publishedArtifact) { }
    private final SegmentJournal journal;
    private final LinkedHashMap<String, Task> tasks = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Document> documents = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,String> scanCursors = new HashMap<>();
    private final int capacity, perTenant, maxAttempts;
    private boolean closed;
    private static void text(String s) {
        if (s == null || s.isBlank() || s.length() > 512 || s.indexOf('/') >= 0 || s.indexOf('\0') >= 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("bounded identifier, no slash or NUL");
        try { SegmentJournal.utf8(s); } catch (Exception e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid Unicode", e); }
    }
    private static void time(long n) { if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative time"); }
    public TaskOrchestrationLab(Path dir, int capacity, int perTenant, int maxAttempts) throws IOException {
        if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 500 || perTenant < 1 || perTenant > capacity || maxAttempts < 1 || maxAttempts > 100)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("bounded configuration");
        this.capacity = capacity; this.perTenant = perTenant; this.maxAttempts = maxAttempts;
        journal = new SegmentJournal(dir);
        try {
            for (SegmentJournal.Record r : journal.records()) apply(r.payload());
            if (tasks.size() > capacity) throw new IOException("capacity lower than existing identity ledger");
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) {
            try { journal.close(); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if(e != cleanup)e.addSuppressed(cleanup); } throw e;
        }
    }
    private void usable() throws IOException { if (closed) throw new IOException("closed"); journal.size(); }
    private static boolean terminal(State s) { return Set.of(State.SUCCEEDED, State.FAILED, State.EXPIRED, State.CANCELLED).contains(s); }
    private static void string(DataOutputStream d, String s) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(s);
        if (s.length() > 4096) throw new IllegalArgumentException("string exceeds durable format limit");
        byte[] b = SegmentJournal.utf8(s);
        if (b.length > 4096) throw new IllegalArgumentException("string exceeds durable format limit");
        d.writeInt(b.length); d.write(b);
    }
    private static String string(DataInputStream d) throws IOException {
        int n = d.readInt(); if (n < 0 || n > 4096 || n > d.available()) throw new IOException("bad string size");
        byte[] b = d.readNBytes(n); String s = new String(b, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (!Arrays.equals(b, SegmentJournal.utf8(s))) throw new IOException("bad UTF-8"); return s;
    }
    private static void input(DataOutputStream d, Input i) throws IOException {
        string(d,i.tenant()); string(d,i.requestId()); string(d,i.document()); d.writeLong(i.version());
        string(d,i.snapshot()); string(d,i.sha256()); d.writeLong(i.inputBytes()); d.writeLong(i.deadline()); d.writeInt(i.priority());
    }
    private static Input input(DataInputStream d) throws IOException {
        return new Input(string(d),string(d),string(d),d.readLong(),string(d),string(d),d.readLong(),d.readLong(),d.readInt());
    }
    private static byte[] event(Task t, String documentKey, Document doc) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream b = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (DataOutputStream d = new DataOutputStream(b)) {
            d.writeInt(1); d.writeBoolean(t != null);
            if (t != null) {
                input(d,t.input()); d.writeInt(t.stage().ordinal()); d.writeInt(t.state().ordinal()); d.writeLong(t.epoch());
                d.writeInt(t.attempts()); string(d,t.owner()); d.writeLong(t.leaseUntil()); d.writeLong(t.readyAt());
                string(d,t.artifact()); d.writeLong(t.revision());
            }
            d.writeBoolean(doc != null);
            if (doc != null) { string(d,documentKey); d.writeLong(doc.version()); d.writeBoolean(doc.deleted()); string(d,doc.publishedArtifact()); }
        }
        return b.toByteArray();
    }
    private void apply(byte[] bytes) throws IOException {
        try (DataInputStream d = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))) {
            int format = d.readInt();
            if (format == 2) { String name=string(d), cursor=string(d); if(d.available()!=0)throw new IOException("trailing cursor bytes"); scanCursors.put(name,cursor); return; }
            if (format != 1) throw new IOException("unknown task event version");
            if (d.readBoolean()) {
                Input i = input(d); int stage = d.readInt(), state = d.readInt();
                if (stage < 0 || stage >= Stage.values().length || state < 0 || state >= State.values().length) throw new IOException("bad enum");
                Task t = new Task(i,Stage.values()[stage],State.values()[state],d.readLong(),d.readInt(),string(d),
                        d.readLong(),d.readLong(),string(d),d.readLong());
                Task old = tasks.get(i.key());
                if (t.revision() != (old == null ? 0 : old.revision() + 1) || (old != null && !old.input().equals(i)))
                    throw new IOException("invalid task history");
                tasks.put(i.key(),t);
            }
            if (d.readBoolean()) { String key = string(d); Document doc = new Document(d.readLong(),d.readBoolean(),string(d)); documents.put(key,doc); }
            if (d.available() != 0) throw new IOException("trailing task bytes");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) { throw new IOException("invalid task event", e); }
    }
    private void persist(Task task, String key, Document doc) throws IOException {
        byte[] b = event(task,key,doc); journal.append("transition-" + journal.size(),b); apply(b);
    }
    public synchronized Task submit(Input input, long now) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); Objects.requireNonNull(input);
        Task old = tasks.get(input.key());
        if (old != null) {
            if (!old.input().equals(input)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("same request, different immutable input");
            return old; // Return original receipt even after its deadline.
        }
        if (input.deadline() <= now || tasks.size() >= capacity) throw new IllegalStateException("admission rejected");
        long count = tasks.values().stream().filter(t -> t.input().tenant().equals(input.tenant())).count();
        if (count >= perTenant) throw new IllegalStateException("tenant identity budget full");
        Document doc = documents.get(input.documentKey());
        if (doc != null && input.version() <= doc.version()) throw new IllegalStateException("new request must advance document version");
        Task t = new Task(input,Stage.PARSE,State.READY,0,0,"",0,now,"",0);
        // Task obligation and active generation become durable in one local record.
        persist(t,input.documentKey(),new Document(input.version(),false,"")); return t;
    }
    public synchronized String scanCursor(String name) throws IOException { usable(); return scanCursors.getOrDefault(name,""); }
    public synchronized void saveScanCursor(String name,String cursor) throws IOException {
        usable(); text(name);
        ByteArrayOutputStream b=new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try(DataOutputStream d=new DataOutputStream(b)){d.writeInt(2);string(d,name);string(d,cursor);}
        byte[] bytes=b.toByteArray();journal.append("transition-"+journal.size(),bytes);apply(bytes);
    }
    public synchronized Task get(String key) throws IOException { usable(); return tasks.get(key); }
    public synchronized Document document(String key) throws IOException { usable(); return documents.get(key); }
    public synchronized List<Task> snapshot() throws IOException { usable(); return List.copyOf(tasks.values()); }
    private Task require(String key) { Task t = tasks.get(key); if (t == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown task"); return t; }
    private static Task change(Task t, Stage stage, State state, long epoch, int attempts, String owner,
                               long lease, long ready, String artifact) {
        return new Task(t.input(),stage,state,epoch,attempts,owner,lease,ready,artifact,Math.incrementExact(t.revision()));
    }
    private boolean current(Task t) {
        Document d = documents.get(t.input().documentKey()); return d != null && !d.deleted() && d.version() == t.input().version();
    }
    public synchronized Task claim(String key, String worker, long now, long ttl) throws IOException {
        usable(); text(worker); time(now);
        if (ttl <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("lease");
        Task t = require(key);
        if (t.state() != State.READY || t.readyAt() > now || now >= t.input().deadline() || !current(t)
                || t.attempts() >= maxAttempts) return null;
        long lease = now + Math.min(ttl, t.input().deadline() - now);
        Task n = change(t,t.stage(),State.RUNNING,Math.incrementExact(t.epoch()),t.attempts()+1,worker,lease,t.readyAt(),t.artifact());
        persist(n,null,null); return n;
    }
    private boolean owns(Task t, Task ticket, long now) {
        return ticket != null && t.input().equals(ticket.input()) && t.stage() == ticket.stage()
                && t.state() == State.RUNNING && t.epoch() == ticket.epoch() && t.owner().equals(ticket.owner())
                && now < t.leaseUntil() && now < t.input().deadline() && current(t);
    }
    public synchronized boolean heartbeat(Task ticket, long now, long ttl) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); if (ttl <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("lease");
        Task t = require(ticket.input().key()); if (!owns(t,ticket,now)) return false;
        long lease = now + Math.min(ttl,t.input().deadline()-now);
        persist(change(t,t.stage(),t.state(),t.epoch(),t.attempts(),t.owner(),lease,t.readyAt(),t.artifact()),null,null); return true;
    }
    public synchronized boolean complete(Task ticket, String artifact, long now) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); text(artifact);
        Task t = require(ticket.input().key()); if (!owns(t,ticket,now)) return false;
        completeKnown(t,artifact,now,false); return true;
    }
    private void completeKnown(Task t, String artifact, long now, boolean reconciling) throws IOException {
        // A trusted remote receipt can arrive after deadline. Record outcome without publishing stale/cancelled work.
        boolean publishable = current(t) && now < t.input().deadline() && t.state() != State.CANCEL_REQUESTED;
        if (!publishable) {
            State end = t.state() == State.CANCEL_REQUESTED || !current(t) ? State.CANCELLED : State.EXPIRED;
            persist(change(t,t.stage(),end,t.epoch(),t.attempts(),"",0,now,artifact),null,null); return;
        }
        Stage next = Stage.values()[t.stage().ordinal()+1]; boolean finished = next == Stage.DONE;
        Task n = change(t,next,finished?State.SUCCEEDED:State.READY,t.epoch(),0,"",0,now,artifact);
        // The stage checkpoint and successor obligation share one durable record.
        persist(n,finished?t.input().documentKey():null,finished?new Document(t.input().version(),false,artifact):null);
    }
    public synchronized boolean retryKnownSafe(Task ticket, long now, long delay) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); if (delay < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("delay");
        Task t = require(ticket.input().key()); if (!owns(t,ticket,now)) return false;
        long ready = now + Math.min(delay,t.input().deadline()-now);
        State s = t.attempts() >= maxAttempts ? State.FAILED : ready >= t.input().deadline()?State.EXPIRED:State.READY;
        persist(change(t,t.stage(),s,t.epoch(),t.attempts(),"",0,ready,t.artifact()),null,null); return true;
    }
    public synchronized boolean markUnknown(Task ticket, long now) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); Task t = require(ticket.input().key());
        if (!owns(t,ticket,now)) return false;
        persist(change(t,t.stage(),State.UNKNOWN,t.epoch(),t.attempts(),t.owner(),t.leaseUntil(),t.readyAt(),t.artifact()),null,null); return true;
    }
    public synchronized State cancel(String key, long now) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); Task t = require(key); if (terminal(t.state())) return t.state();
        State s = t.state()==State.READY?State.CANCELLED:State.CANCEL_REQUESTED;
        if (s != t.state()) persist(change(t,t.stage(),s,t.epoch(),t.attempts(),t.owner(),t.leaseUntil(),t.readyAt(),t.artifact()),null,null);
        return s;
    }
    public synchronized void deleteDocument(String key, long version) throws IOException {
        usable(); Document d = documents.get(key);
        if (d == null || version <= d.version()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("advance tombstone generation");
        persist(null,key,new Document(version,true,""));
    }
    /** Returns at most limit rows; this bounded local model still scans/sorts up to 500 tasks. */
    public synchronized List<Task> page(String after, int limit) throws IOException {
        usable(); if (limit < 1 || limit > 500) throw new IllegalArgumentException("page limit");
        return tasks.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> after == null || e.getKey().compareTo(after)>0)
                .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()).limit(limit).map(Map.Entry::getValue).toList();
    }
    public synchronized boolean recover(String key, long observedRevision, long now) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); Task t = require(key); if (t.revision()!=observedRevision || terminal(t.state())) return false;
        State s = t.state();
        if (s == State.RUNNING && now >= t.leaseUntil()) s = State.UNKNOWN;
        else if (s == State.READY && (!current(t) || now >= t.input().deadline())) s = !current(t)?State.CANCELLED:State.EXPIRED;
        if (s == t.state()) return false;
        persist(change(t,t.stage(),s,t.epoch(),t.attempts(),t.owner(),t.leaseUntil(),t.readyAt(),t.artifact()),null,null); return true;
    }
    /** NOT_STARTED_AND_FENCED requires proof the old remote operation cannot later begin. */
    public synchronized boolean reconcile(String key, long epoch, Receipt receipt, String artifact, long now) throws IOException {
        usable(); time(now); Objects.requireNonNull(receipt); Task t = require(key);
        if (t.epoch()!=epoch || (t.state()!=State.UNKNOWN && t.state()!=State.CANCEL_REQUESTED)) return false;
        if (receipt == Receipt.UNRESOLVED) return false;
        if (receipt == Receipt.SUCCEEDED) { text(artifact); completeKnown(t,artifact,now,true); return true; }
        State end;
        if (receipt == Receipt.FAILED) end = State.FAILED;
        else if (t.state()==State.CANCEL_REQUESTED || !current(t)) end = State.CANCELLED;
        else if (now >= t.input().deadline()) end = State.EXPIRED;
        else if (t.attempts() >= maxAttempts) end = State.FAILED;
        else end = State.READY;
        persist(change(t,t.stage(),end,t.epoch(),t.attempts(),"",0,now,t.artifact()),null,null); return true;
    }
    /** A file-backed task exists independently of the wake-up. A real adapter must also run its recovery loop. */
    public synchronized boolean durableResponsibility(String key) throws IOException { usable(); return tasks.containsKey(key); }
    @Override public synchronized void close() throws IOException { if (!closed) { closed=true; journal.close(); } }

    /** Local admission gate: concurrency reservation, not a QPS limiter. One caller owns scheduling. */
    public static final class FairGate {
        private final int total, reservedP0;
        private final Map<String,Integer> running = new HashMap<>();
        /** Identity is intentionally per acquisition, even when the same Task object is selected again. */
        public static final class Permit {
            private final Task task;
            private Permit(Task task) { this.task = task; }
            public Task task() { return task; }
        }
        private final Map<String,Permit> permits = new HashMap<>();
        private String lastTenant = "";
        public FairGate(int total, int reservedP0) {
            if(total<1 || reservedP0<0 || reservedP0>=total) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            this.total=total;this.reservedP0=reservedP0;
        }
        public synchronized Permit choose(List<Task> all, long now) {
            time(now); if(permits.size()>=total)return null;
            List<String> tenants=all.stream().filter(t -> eligible(t,now)).map(t -> t.input().tenant()).distinct().sorted().toList();
            if(tenants.isEmpty())return null;
            String tenant=tenants.stream().filter(s -> s.compareTo(lastTenant)>0).findFirst().orElse(tenants.getFirst());
            Task t=all.stream().filter(x -> x.input().tenant().equals(tenant)&&eligible(x,now))
                    .min(Comparator.comparingInt((Task x) -> now-x.readyAt()>=1000?0:x.input().priority())
                            .thenComparingLong(Task::readyAt).thenComparing(x -> x.input().key())).orElseThrow();
            Permit permit=new Permit(t);
            permits.put(t.input().key(),permit);running.merge(tenant,1,Integer::sum);lastTenant=tenant;return permit;
        }
        private boolean eligible(Task t,long now) {
            return t.state()==State.READY && t.readyAt()<=now && now<t.input().deadline() && !permits.containsKey(t.input().key())
                    && running.getOrDefault(t.input().tenant(),0)<Math.max(1,total/2)
                    && (t.input().priority()==0 || permits.size()<total-reservedP0);
        }
        public synchronized void release(Permit permit) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(permit); Task t=permit.task();
            if(permits.remove(t.input().key(),permit))running.compute(t.input().tenant(),(k,n)->n==null||n<=1?null:n-1);
        }
        public synchronized int inFlight(){return permits.size();}
    }
}

上述两文件放同一目录、Java 21 编译。FairGate 是 TaskOrchestrationLab 的嵌套类，单调度者只传入该存储产生的最多 500 条可信 Task；公平是获取机会，不是完成时间 SLA。SegmentJournal 使用专用已存在目录、单类加载器合作所有者、稳定 fileKey、文件锁和目录 force 的本地文件系统；所有者持有期间不得替换路径或硬链接/另行开关锁文件。最多 10000 日志记录/16 MiB，不具复制、自动压缩、网络分区安全或任意断电保证；写入应答未知时关闭并按原身份恢复核对。

推荐链路：

  1. 初始化上传：客户端先计算 SHA-256，请求 initUpload(fileHash, fileName, size, totalChunks)。
  2. 秒传判断：服务端查 file_hash 表，如果完整文件已存在，直接创建用户文件记录并返回完成。
  3. 返回上传状态：如果未完成，服务端返回已上传分片 Bitmap 或缺失分片列表。
  4. 上传分片：每片上传到 MinIO 临时路径，成功后设置 Redis Bitmap 对应位。
  5. 完成合并：当 BITCOUNT == totalChunks，抢占合并锁，按序合并分片，校验 SHA-256。
  6. 状态落库：文件状态从 UPLOADING 变为 UPLOADED，写入完整对象地址。
  7. 异步处理：投递 FILE_UPLOADED 事件，消费者执行解析、切片、Embedding、索引写入和 Wiki 编译。

核心表设计：

Answer.java
CREATE TABLE file_asset (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    size BIGINT NOT NULL,
    object_key VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE KEY uk_sha256_size (sha256, size)
);

CREATE TABLE user_file (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    file_asset_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    file_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
    KEY idx_user_created (user_id, created_at)
);

Redis Key 示例：

Answer.java
upload:bitmap:{uploadId}       # bitmap 记录分片完成情况
upload:meta:{uploadId}         # hash 记录 fileHash、totalChunks、size
upload:merge-lock:{uploadId}   # 防止重复合并

伪代码：

Answer.java
public void uploadChunk(String uploadId, int chunkIndex, byte[] bytes) {
    UploadMeta meta = loadMeta(uploadId);
    minio.putObject(tempKey(uploadId, chunkIndex), bytes);
    redis.setBit("upload:bitmap:" + uploadId, chunkIndex, true);

    long uploaded = redis.bitCount("upload:bitmap:" + uploadId);
    if (uploaded == meta.totalChunks() && tryLock("upload:merge-lock:" + uploadId)) {
        mergeAndPublish(uploadId, meta);
    }
}

注意：合并和发消息必须处理一致性。简单方案是本地事务更新文件状态后再发 MQ；更稳的是 Outbox 表，事务内写业务状态和事件表，再由后台任务投递 MQ。

Weighted RRF 伪代码：

Answer.java
public Map<String, Double> weightedRrf(List<SearchResult> bm25,
                                      List<SearchResult> vector,
                                      List<SearchResult> wiki) {
    Map<String, Double> score = new HashMap<>();
    add(score, bm25, 1.0, 60);
    add(score, vector, 0.9, 60);
    add(score, wiki, 1.2, 60);
    return score;
}

private void add(Map<String, Double> score, List<SearchResult> list, double weight, int k) {
    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
        String chunkId = list.get(i).chunkId();
        score.merge(chunkId, weight / (k + i + 1), Double::sum);
    }
}

权限处理要主动讲清楚：如果权限字段能进入 ES filter，应尽量在召回阶段过滤，减少越权风险和无效候选；如果向量库过滤能力弱，则召回数量要扩大，再做严格后过滤，但必须防止过滤后候选不足。

Query改写、HyDE、混合检索与GraphRAG的完整多通道方案

先保留原query并明确用户意图，再受控生成少量改写或HyDE假想文档，用词法、向量和必要的图关系通道补足不同证据，按统一身份与权限融合去重，重排并在预算内组织真实来源。评估既看单路覆盖，也看合并的增量贡献、排序、最终证据支持与成本，不能只比返回数量。

可能的问法

  • 如何组合用户意图改写、HyDE、向量与 BM25 混合检索，以及图谱与向量的 GraphRAG？
  • 怎样衡量各通道的增量召回、最终证据支持度、延迟与费用？

输入、输出与前提

多通道改写、HyDE 与 GraphRAG 应分别解释生成了什么查询、从哪里取证据、怎样验证，以及如何控制预算。学习方案不能替代真实项目经历或质量指标。

为什么这样做

用户意图改写：从允许使用的历史中解析指代、补齐主语、保留实体、数字、时间范围和否定条件，输出可独立检索的问句；复杂问题可以拆成可回答子问题，但不能把未知事实写进查询作为已知条件。原始query保留一路以防语义漂移；控制改写数、长度、温度与调用预算，歧义影响结论时询问用户而不是随便选。结构字段如年份、作者最好作为过滤条件，权限过滤由服务端身份产生，不能信任模型生成。

HyDE与改写不一样：先让语言模型生成一段假想相关文档，再用文档编码器将其embedding去检索真实语料；假想段落可能包含错误，只用于构造检索表示，不是证据，也不进入最终引用或直接存成事实。它利用文档与文档在向量空间的关联缓解短问句与长答案的差距；也可能引入领域偏置、错误专名，增加一次生成成本。可以保留原query向量/词法路与之并行，再看消融实验是否值得开启。

混合检索在相同可访问版本集合上分别运行 BM25 与 dense。词法擅长编号与专名，dense 擅长语义改写；按 chunk/document 和 version 取并集去重，保留各路 rank/score 便于分析。加权 RRF=Σw/(c+rank) 避免直接比较不同尺度的原始分数，也可用验证集校准后融合；每路候选上限与总超时共同约束预算。完整代码见本章 RankFusion。

GraphRAG不只等于“向量库再加图数据库”：索引侧从原文提取实体与关系，实体消歧并保留每条边/断言的原文、版本和权限来源；具体项目可用人工图谱或LLM抽取，后者会出错。查询侧向量匹配实体描述作为入口，按受限跳数/边类型扩展关系，再回取关联原文块，过滤、排序、裁剪后作答。适合关系型或多跳证据；常规独立事实问题未必值得付出构图/维护成本。

Microsoft GraphRAG 的 local search 偏向指定实体相关的邻域和原始文档；global search 用图社区预摘要组织全局主题，通过分批 map 提炼相关要点、reduce 汇总。“整个资料库有哪些主题”与“论文 A 用了哪个数据集”需要不同路线，不能将 global 简化为单实体 BFS。摘要和关系都是派生数据，必须追溯原始文档，更新或撤权时同步失效；社区摘要不天然等于准确引用。

多通道评估先建包含query、相关证据ID/版本与相关等级的保留集，覆盖精确词、改写、否定、时间、无答案和多跳。每路Recall@K=命中相关数/标注相关总数；并集Recall检验互补性，unique gain看某路新增的真实相关证据，重叠率可解释冗余但高重叠不自动好或坏。保持总候选/token/延迟预算一致，比较原query单路、加BM25、加改写、加HyDE、加图等消融，防仅因多花预算误归因。

融合与重排评估MRR=各query首个相关名次倒数的平均，适合关心首个答案；多证据任务再用Recall和nDCG@K，DCG可用Σ(2^rel−1)/log2(rank+1)，除理想排序DCG，IDCG=0的无答案样本单独统计。生成端核对答案正确、引用是否支持每项论断、证据完整性与拒答；记录检索/改写/图遍历/重排/生成的分段p95/p99、token和费用。ANN Recall相对精确近邻是索引指标，不能替代人工相关性Recall。

失败定位沿trace：文档未入库/解析丢失→权限版本过滤→改写漂移→通道漏召回→融合挤出→重排降权→预算删掉→生成忽视证据。留出未参与调参的测试集，按同一query配对比较并报告不确定性；相关证据集合可能漏标需人工复核，不能把未标注项自动视为无关。

例子与推演

示例“它在2024年以前用了哪些数据集”：先确定“它”的论文实体，保留“以前”；词法匹配数据集名、向量召回改写段落、图路找uses关系，再验证每条边对应原文和时间。HyDE若编出一个数据集名，只有真实原文支持才能进入答案。

标注相关证据{a,b,c}，词法命中{a,x}、向量命中{b,x}时各Recall=1/3，合并Recall=2/3；若图路只返回x无新增相关就没有本例增量覆盖，返回更多本身不算成功。该手算示例不声称真实线上提升。

复杂度与正确性

多路并发的延迟通常由慢路与融合重排共同决定，资源费用则会相加；超时放弃一路可能损失覆盖，需显式降级。图遍历在实际访问的 V′、E′ 子图上可为 O(V′+E′)，但必须限制跳数、扇出和上下文规模，还要计入构图与模型摘要的代价。

边界、反例与追问

用户意图改写、HyDE生成、图谱构建、检索融合与最终生成是不同环节，排错和评估应逐层分离。

私有语料需要每个通道、图边、父块回取和缓存都遵守ACL；检索文本视作数据，不能执行其夹带指令。强权限隔离比多拿几条候选更优先。

RankFusion.java 完整核心

来源：算法与数据结构面试手册 L26764 起的完整原始围栏，原文与 SHA 归档于本次来源审计。Java 21；各路先限定候选量和 ID 长度，并保证输入在调用期间不变。ID 必须无歧义包含授权范围及文档/块版本；每路重复 ID 只按首次原始位置贡献一次。零权重仍保留零分候选，topK 仅限制输出，不限制全量排序成本。共 M 个排名槽、U 个唯一 ID，期望 O(M+U log U) 时间、O(U) 及单路去重空间；字符串成本另计。

RankFusion.java · 算法与数据结构原始围栏
import java.util.*;

public final class RankFusion {
    private RankFusion() {}
    public record Hit(String id, double score) {}
    // Ranks use the original first occurrence's 1-based position in each list.
    public static List<Hit> rrf(List<List<String>> rankings,
                               double[] weights, double c, int topK) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(rankings);
        Objects.requireNonNull(weights);
        if (weights.length != rankings.size() || !Double.isFinite(c)
                || c <= 0 || topK < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        Map<String, Double> scores = new HashMap<>();
        // Caller keeps the lists stable during this invocation. Iteration supports LinkedList.
        double[] weightSnapshot = weights.clone();
        int channel = 0;
        for (List<String> row : rankings) {
            double w = weightSnapshot[channel++];
            if (!Double.isFinite(w) || w < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            List<String> list = Objects.requireNonNull(row);
            Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
            int position = 0;
            for (String inputId : list) {
                int i = position++; // Preserve original slots, including duplicates.
                String id = Objects.requireNonNull(inputId);
                if (id.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty id");
                if (!seen.add(id)) continue;
                double score = scores.getOrDefault(id, 0.0) + w / (c + i + 1.0);
                if (!Double.isFinite(score)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("overflow");
                scores.put(id, score);
            }
        }
        List<Hit> out = new ArrayList<>();
        scores.forEach((id, score) -> out.add(new Hit(id, score)));
        out.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(Hit::score).reversed().thenComparing(Hit::id));
        return new ArrayList<>(out.subList(0, Math.min(topK, out.size())));
    }
}

变体 1：Redis 宕机怎么办？

分析：限流在主链路上，不能让所有请求阻塞。答案按业务选择：登录/支付风控倾向 fail-close 或本地严格限流；普通读接口可 fail-open 并打告警；同时本地令牌桶兜底。

变体 2：热点 Key 被打爆怎么办？

分析：单个 Redis Key 的操作无法水平扩展。答案：拆分维度、热点用户本地预限流、分片 Key 后汇总近似判断，或把强限流前置到网关/WAF。

变体 3：令牌桶怎么写？

分析：令牌桶不存每次请求，只存当前令牌数和上次补充时间。每次请求先按时间差补充令牌，再判断是否扣减。优点是内存 O(1)，缺点是对“窗口内精确次数”不如 ZSET 精确。

patches.original:
删除成功之后怎样阻止旧缓存复活

测试结论应注明运行时版本、输入、环境与验证范围。局部教学测试、有限样本和假设性能参数不能替代真实集成验收，也不能当作个人生产项目成绩。

删除成功之后怎样阻止旧缓存复活

缓存侧保存最低可接受版本 floor，失效事件单调推进它，回填时原子拒绝低于 floor 或当前缓存版本的值。 这保证的是已知失效版本之后不倒退；事件未到、屏障丢失和落后副本仍需单独处理。

假设数据库是事实来源，一个实体每次成功写入都会增加业务 version。这里的 version 不是墙上时钟；并发更新必须在数据库内串行递增或用等价的单实体顺序机制生成。同一实体同一 version 必须对应相同业务内容，删除也须有版本化的失效语义；不能让两个不同结果共用一个版本。

先做一条确定性的反例时序

1. 读者 R 缓存未命中，从数据库读出 v7，把结果暂存在进程里，暂停。

2. 写者 W 提交 v8，并成功删除缓存。

3. R 恢复，SET v7 并设置 10 分钟 TTL。

4. 新读者命中 v7。删除成功和 TTL 存在都没有阻止旧值回填。

把 R 暂停到第二次删除之后，同样能反驳“固定睡 500ms 就一定正确”。TTL 从旧值实际写入时开始计算；如果读者可无限暂停，就不能从数据库提交时刻推出固定陈旧上界。

一个有边界的版本屏障设计

为实体保留两个同槽 key：cache:{entity}:floor 存已知最低可接受版本，cache:{entity}:data 存 version 和 payload。写者在数据库同一事务中写业务 v8 与失效事件；事件消费者在 Redis 中原子推进 floor 到 max(floor,8)，并删除版本低于 floor 的 data。回填脚本拒绝 version<floor，也拒绝覆盖更高 data 版本。

floor 不跟随 data 的普通 TTL 一起消失。否则 data 一过期，旧读者又可以在空槽中复活旧值。若担心 floor 无限增长，需要有证明过的回收条件，例如所有旧读者已过最大生存期且不会从旧副本读；不能仅凭“这个 key 很久没人访问”删除屏障。

patches.original:
以下状态机用于拆解责任；消费去重记录、业务效果和成功记录必须同事务提交，确认只在本地完成或恢复责任持久转交后发生。状态机示意：

responsibility-state.txt
业务责任示意（不是 Java 程序，也不是 broker 的原子状态机）：
INIT -> SAVED -> PUBLISHED -> CONSUMING -> SUCCESS
CONSUMING -> RETRYING -> DEAD
CONSUMING -> FAILED_COMPENSATABLE
COMMIT_UNKNOWN -> 同身份核对已提交回执；确认前不 ACK
SUCCESS / 已提交恢复任务 -> 尝试 ACK；ACK_UNKNOWN 不撤销已提交效果

核心设计：

  1. 接入事件时生成全局 eventId，业务表和 event_task 表在同一个 MySQL 事务内落库。
  2. 后台发布器扫描 SAVED 状态事件，发送 MQ。
  3. 开启 Publisher Confirm，确认成功后把状态改为 PUBLISHED；失败则保留待重试。
  4. 消费者以受信 (tenant, consumer, event) 为身份，在同一权威事务内检查不可变 payload、写 inbox、本地效果或发送任务责任及完成回执；重复身份必须核对已提交结果，不能只凭插入失败判断成功。
  5. 业务效果、去重与成功记录同事务提交后才手动 ACK；持久任务状态为 SUCCESS。
  6. 处理失败时按错误类型决定重试或死信；超过最大次数进入 DEAD，等待人工或补偿任务处理。重试/隔离责任未确认落库时不 ACK；仅告警日志或一次 NACK 不证明可靠转交。
  7. XXL-Job 可扫描 SAVED/PUBLISHED/RETRYING/CONSUMING 超时责任；按权威状态与稳定身份恢复。UNKNOWN 先核对，不能仅因超时就换身份重投或宣告失败。

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Java 21, no dependencies. Bounded transaction CONTRACT MODEL, not a database adapter. */
public final class InboxModel {
    private InboxModel() { }
    enum Plan { LOCAL_EFFECT, RETRY_TASK, QUARANTINE_TASK }
    enum Fault { NONE, AFTER_INBOX, EFFECT, OUTAGE, PERMISSION, OTHER_UNIQUE, HANDOFF, LOST_COMMIT_REPLY }
    enum Outcome { ACKED, COMMIT_UNKNOWN, NOT_COMMITTED, CONFLICT, ACK_UNKNOWN }
    record Key(String tenant, String consumer, String event) {
        Key { token(tenant); token(consumer); token(event); }
    }
    record Message(Key key, String canonicalPayload) {
        Message { Objects.requireNonNull(key); token(canonicalPayload); }
    }
    record Receipt(String payload, Plan plan, String result, Key externalRequestIdentity) { }
    record State(Map<Key, Receipt> inbox, Map<Key, Integer> effects, Map<Key, Receipt> tasks) {
        State { inbox = Map.copyOf(inbox); effects = Map.copyOf(effects); tasks = Map.copyOf(tasks); }
    }
    static final class StoreFailure extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
        StoreFailure(String message) { super(message); }
    }
    static final class CommitUnknown extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    }
    static final class PayloadConflict extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    }
    interface Transactions {
        // Returned receipt MUST mean confirmed atomic commit. UNKNOWN must never be guessed as success.
        Receipt apply(Message message, Plan plan) throws StoreFailure, CommitUnknown, PayloadConflict;
    }
    interface Acknowledger { void ack() throws Exception; }

    /** Serializes commits. Immutable snapshots simulate an independently surviving store across worker restart.
     * JVM/process loss loses this store. No MySQL, broker, network send or disk durability is implemented.
     */
    static final class MemoryTransactions implements Transactions {
        private final int capacity;
        private State committed;
        private Fault nextFault = Fault.NONE;
        private CountDownLatch entered;
        private CountDownLatch release;
        MemoryTransactions(int capacity) { this(capacity, new State(Map.of(), Map.of(), Map.of())); }
        MemoryTransactions(int capacity, State image) {
            if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 256 || image.inbox().size() > capacity) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity");
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.committed = image;
        }
        synchronized void inject(Fault fault) { nextFault = fault; }
        synchronized void gate(CountDownLatch inside, CountDownLatch resume) { entered = inside; release = resume; }
        synchronized State image() { return committed; }
        @Override public synchronized Receipt apply(Message message, Plan plan)
                throws StoreFailure, CommitUnknown, PayloadConflict {
            Objects.requireNonNull(plan);
            Fault fault = nextFault;
            nextFault = Fault.NONE;
            if (fault == Fault.OUTAGE || fault == Fault.PERMISSION || fault == Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE)
                throw new StoreFailure(fault.name()); // Never classify arbitrary errors as duplicate delivery.
            Receipt prior = committed.inbox().get(message.key());
            if (prior != null) {
                if (!prior.payload().equals(message.canonicalPayload())) throw new PayloadConflict();
                return prior; // Recovery reads confirmed committed result, not just existence of a key.
            }
            if (committed.inbox().size() == capacity) throw new StoreFailure("capacity; retain broker ownership");
            if (entered != null) {
                entered.countDown();
                try {
                    if (!release.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new StoreFailure("test gate timeout");
                } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw new StoreFailure("interrupted before commit");
                } finally { entered = null; release = null; }
            }
            Map<Key, Receipt> inbox = new HashMap<>(committed.inbox());
            Map<Key, Integer> effects = new HashMap<>(committed.effects());
            Map<Key, Receipt> tasks = new HashMap<>(committed.tasks());
            Receipt receipt = new Receipt(message.canonicalPayload(), plan,
                    plan == Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT ? "local-accounting-applied" : "responsibility-stored", message.key());
            inbox.put(message.key(), receipt); // Private transaction workspace, invisible before commit.
            if (fault == Fault.AFTER_INBOX) throw new StoreFailure("rollback after inbox insert");
            if (plan == Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT) {
                if (fault == Fault.EFFECT) throw new StoreFailure("effect rolled back");
                effects.merge(message.key(), 1, Math::addExact); // Pure local mutation, NEVER a remote notification.
            } else {
                if (fault == Fault.HANDOFF) throw new StoreFailure("task persistence failed");
                tasks.put(message.key(), receipt); // Outbox task and stable external request key committed together.
            }
            committed = new State(inbox, effects, tasks); // Single linearization point.
            if (fault == Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY) throw new CommitUnknown();
            return receipt;
        }
    }
    static Outcome consume(Transactions database, Message message, Plan plan, Acknowledger broker) {
        try {
            database.apply(message, plan);
        } catch (CommitUnknown ex) { return Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN;
        } catch (PayloadConflict ex) { return Outcome.CONFLICT;
        } catch (StoreFailure ex) { return Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED; }
        // Separate boundary: ACK failure cannot roll back, quarantine or repeat a committed local effect.
        try { broker.ack(); return Outcome.ACKED; }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            if (ex instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }
    static void token(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty() || value.length() > 256) throw new IllegalArgumentException("1..256 UTF-16 units");
    }
    static Message msg(String tenant, String consumer, String event, String payload) {
        return new Message(new Key(tenant, consumer, event), payload);
    }
    static void check(boolean condition, String test) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(test); }
    static void passed(String name) { System.out.println("PASS " + name); }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Message message = msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1");
        MemoryTransactions database = new MemoryTransactions(32);
        CountDownLatch entered = new CountDownLatch(1), resume = new CountDownLatch(1), duplicateStarted = new CountDownLatch(1);
        database.gate(entered, resume);
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try {
            Future<Outcome> first = executor.submit(() -> consume(database, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }));
            check(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "first entered transaction");
            Future<Outcome> duplicate = executor.submit(() -> {
                duplicateStarted.countDown(); return consume(database, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
            });
            check(duplicateStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "duplicate started");
            check(!duplicate.isDone(), "duplicate before settle cannot acknowledge");
            resume.countDown();
            check(first.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED && duplicate.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED, "both settled");
            check(database.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "one effect");
            passed("concurrent identity; duplicate blocks until first transaction settles");
        } finally { resume.countDown(); executor.shutdownNow(); check(executor.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "executor stopped"); }
        check(consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "changed"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.CONFLICT, "payload conflict");
        passed("same identity different payload conflicts");
        for (Fault fault : new Fault[]{Fault.AFTER_INBOX, Fault.EFFECT, Fault.OUTAGE, Fault.PERMISSION, Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE}) {
            MemoryTransactions failed = new MemoryTransactions(2); failed.inject(fault);
            check(consume(failed, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, fault.name());
            check(failed.image().inbox().isEmpty() && failed.image().effects().isEmpty(), "rollback " + fault);
            passed("no ACK/no committed inbox on " + fault);
        }
        MemoryTransactions uncertain = new MemoryTransactions(2); uncertain.inject(Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY);
        check(consume(uncertain, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK unknown"); }) == Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN, "unknown");
        MemoryTransactions restarted = new MemoryTransactions(2, uncertain.image());
        check(consume(restarted, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "recover");
        check(restarted.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "recovery no effect replay");
        passed("lost commit reply UNKNOWN; simulated restart recovers same committed receipt");
        for (Plan plan : new Plan[]{Plan.RETRY_TASK, Plan.QUARANTINE_TASK}) {
            MemoryTransactions handoff = new MemoryTransactions(2); handoff.inject(Fault.HANDOFF);
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK failed handoff"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "handoff failure");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().isEmpty(), "failed handoff retained upstream");
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "handoff confirmed");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().get(message.key()).externalRequestIdentity().equals(message.key()), "stable request identity");
            passed(plan + " failure retains upstream responsibility; success commits task");
        }
        MemoryTransactions ackFailure = new MemoryTransactions(2);
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new Exception("transport"); }) == Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN, "ack error");
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED && ackFailure.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "ack redelivery");
        passed("ACK transport failure never repeats committed effect");
        consume(database, msg("tenant-b", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "audit", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(database.image().effects().size() == 3, "namespace independence"); passed("tenants and consumers independent");
        MemoryTransactions full = new MemoryTransactions(1);
        consume(full, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(consume(full, msg("t", "c", "e", "p"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("capacity ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "capacity");
        passed("bounded capacity rejects without ACK or eviction");
    }
}

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {

            resume.countDown();
            check(first.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED && duplicate.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED, "both settled");
            check(database.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "one effect");
            passed("concurrent identity; duplicate blocks until first transaction settles");
        } finally { resume.countDown(); executor.shutdownNow(); check(executor.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "executor stopped"); }
        check(consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "changed"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.CONFLICT, "payload conflict");
        passed("same identity different payload conflicts");
        for (Fault fault : new Fault[]{Fault.AFTER_INBOX, Fault.EFFECT, Fault.OUTAGE, Fault.PERMISSION, Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE}) {
            MemoryTransactions failed = new MemoryTransactions(2); failed.inject(fault);
            check(consume(failed, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, fault.name());
            check(failed.image().inbox().isEmpty() && failed.image().effects().isEmpty(), "rollback " + fault);
            passed("no ACK/no committed inbox on " + fault);
        }
        MemoryTransactions uncertain = new MemoryTransactions(2); uncertain.inject(Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY);
        check(consume(uncertain, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK unknown"); }) == Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN, "unknown");
        MemoryTransactions restarted = new MemoryTransactions(2, uncertain.image());
        check(consume(restarted, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "recover");
        check(restarted.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "recovery no effect replay");
        passed("lost commit reply UNKNOWN; simulated restart recovers same committed receipt");
        for (Plan plan : new Plan[]{Plan.RETRY_TASK, Plan.QUARANTINE_TASK}) {
            MemoryTransactions handoff = new MemoryTransactions(2); handoff.inject(Fault.HANDOFF);
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK failed handoff"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "handoff failure");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().isEmpty(), "failed handoff retained upstream");
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "handoff confirmed");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().get(message.key()).externalRequestIdentity().equals(message.key()), "stable request identity");
            passed(plan + " failure retains upstream responsibility; success commits task");
        }
        MemoryTransactions ackFailure = new MemoryTransactions(2);
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new Exception("transport"); }) == Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN, "ack error");
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED && ackFailure.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "ack redelivery");
        passed("ACK transport failure never repeats committed effect");
        consume(database, msg("tenant-b", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "audit", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(database.image().effects().size() == 3, "namespace independence"); passed("tenants and consumers independent");
        MemoryTransactions full = new MemoryTransactions(1);
        consume(full, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(consume(full, msg("t", "c", "e", "p"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("capacity ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "capacity");
        passed("bounded capacity rejects without ACK or eviction");
    }
}

运行：保存为 InboxModel.java；使用 JDK 21 执行 javac -Xlint:all -Werror InboxModel.java，再执行 java InboxModel。测试断言覆盖并发重复、payload 冲突、插入后回滚、效果失败、数据库错误、提交响应丢失、重试/隔离失败、ACK 失败、租户/消费者隔离和容量。核心不变量：一次不可变 State 发布同时带上 inbox、效果/责任与原始结果；ACK 使用独立异常边界。
